## Cost analysis

## Don't-do log

- **crop_to_active_grid advisory (2026-05-19)**: Model crops to [1,1,21,21] at node[1] (v15=[21,21]) after 1×1 Conv. Reordering Slice before Conv would create a 10-channel [1,10,21,21] F32 intermediate (17640 bytes) vs original 1-channel [1,1,30,30] (3600 bytes). Cost would increase.
- **row/col diff chain optimization (2026-05-20)**: v43+v44+v45+v46 (row diffs) and v53+v54+v55+v56 (col diffs) are [1,1,20,21] F32 = 1680B each = 13440B total. No reduction possible: Abs/Not-Equal alternatives create same-size intermediates. ReduceMax(v45) without Abs fails for all-negative diffs. Sub-Equal-fold not applicable.
- **v35 [1,1,30,30] elimination**: This is the key compression step (10ch→1ch). Any alternative requires materializing [1,10,21,21]=17640B (17×more). Do not attempt crop-before-Conv.
